name: Kyojin
description: Kyojin is Yamz Labs' open source inference engine for AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151), built on ExLlamaV3 with speculative decoding, serving their own EXL3 quantised builds of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, GLM-5.3-Flash and MiMo-V2.6-Flash (95 to 106 GB) on one 128 GB machine through an OpenAI-compatible API. The script builds the latest tagged release with AMD's gfx1151 ROCm wheels, following Kyojin's own container recipe.

notes.text: Kyojin needs a gfx1151 GPU (Ryzen AI Max+ 395, 128 GB). The container needs /dev/kfd and /dev/dri passed through, which the script sets up when GPU passthrough is enabled.
The install downloads about 14 GB of ROCm wheels and builds the engine, which takes 15 to 30 minutes.
The first start downloads the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next pack (about 95 GB), then loads it. Follow it with: journalctl -fu kyojin
OpenAI-compatible API: http://<IP>:8731/v1. The server has no API key, so keep it on a trusted network.
Change the model (qwen, glm or mimo), context or port in /opt/kyojin/kyojin.env, then run: systemctl restart kyojin
Check the GPU setup with: systemctl stop kyojin && kyojin-check
